title: Target pre-encoding invariant for LinearDiscriminantAnalysis internal helpers
answers: What input format do _class_means and _class_cov expect for target y in LinearDiscriminantAnalysis?
Why do LinearDiscriminantAnalysis solvers pass y_encoded and n_classes to internal helpers?
How to compute class means and covariances with pre-encoded targets in LinearDiscriminantAnalysis?
body:
Invariant: Internal class statistic helpers require targets pre-encoded as zero-based integer codes indexing self.classes_, accompanied by an explicit keyword-only n_classes parameter.
Where enforced: Enforced in sklearn/discriminant_analysis.py:_class_means and sklearn/discriminant_analysis.py:_class_cov.
Consequences: Passing raw labels or omitting n_classes breaks group indexing (y_encoded == idx) and bincount operations, causing shape mismatches or silent mean corruption.
applies: Class mean and covariance helper computations in sklearn/discriminant_analysis.py.
